description.en:
Selectively boost storage capacities on individual placeables.
Console commands (open with ~ key): sbScan - Scan and list all placeables with storages sbBoost ID MUL - Boost placeable #ID by MULx (e.g. sbBoost 3 10) sbReset ID - Reset placeable #ID to original capacity sbResetAll - Reset everything sbStatus - Show all boosted placeables
description.hr:
Selektivno povecaj kapacitete skladista na pojedinacnim placeablima.
Konzolne komande (otvori sa ~ tipkom): sbScan - Skeniraj i pokazi sve placeable sa skladistima sbBoost ID MUL - Pojacaj placeable #ID za MULx (npr. sbBoost 3 10) sbReset ID - Vrati placeable #ID na originalni kapacitet sbResetAll - Vrati sve na originalno sbStatus - Pokazi sve pojacane placeablove
